scope: Canonical memory lifecycle projections through existing search HTTP routes; paper only; no execution-path memory access or model call.

acceptance.evidence: Store mutation hooks project institutional and persona creates, supersedes, explicit archives and expiry to search. Projection metadata carries tenant, persona/relevance scope, institutional scope/filter and source event id; inactive/expired records are tombstones. Tests exercise both store types.

python -m services.memory.search_retrieval replays both stores including tombstones, reports processed/projected/tombstones/failures and exits 1 for failures. Repeated real-Postgres backfill preserves IDs; persisted-store restart test recovers failed projections.

Memory HTTP asks search HTTP for IDs/scores, hydrates owner entries, then rejects missing, inactive, expired, wrong-tenant, wrong-persona, wrong-scope/filter/type/tag candidates. Consultation sessions retain persona_and_committee only. Canonical revalidation also protects fallback and stale tombstones.

Responses expose hybrid, lexical_only or keyword_fallback plus aggregate/per-store reasons. Keyword fallback emits a warning. Search query logging fails closed and carries the real session id. HTTP tests cover hybrid/lexical modes and unavailable logs.

test_memory_http_to_search_http_real_postgres_zh writes through memory HTTP routes, invokes search HTTP handlers through the real JSON/auth client transport, and runs real pgvector/PostgreSQL FTS. Traditional Chinese query 流動性風控 finds the institutional entry although canonical space-splitting retrieval returns no hits; persona query 流動性下單 also succeeds. Supersede/archive tombstones exclude subsequent hits.

validation.result: 12 passed; 8.75 seconds, including three additional canonical revalidation/configuration/persistence tests after the broad run

integration_fixture.database: Existing local retrieval-activation-test-20261113 container, real pgvector/PostgreSQL, localhost:25432; credentials read privately from container configuration and never recorded here.
integration_fixture.transport: FastAPI TestClients for memory and search; urllib JSON requests are bridged to search ASGI handlers. Database queries/indexing/query logging are real. JWTs and entries are test fixtures only.
integration_fixture.embedding: Disabled fixture engine for real SQL test, explicitly lexical_only; separate mocked HTTP test verifies hybrid mode routing. No semantic-quality, hosted-deployment or model-evaluation claim.

operational_limits: Projection failure preserves canonical writes and emits a structured warning with entry/source event identity; replay uses the operator backfill CLI. No automatic retry daemon is introduced. Search outages can reduce recall until replay, while canonical hydration rejects stale tombstones.

Hosted activation requires the existing issuer to provision a memory-svc/system search credential with tenant/persona/workspace grants, valid expiry and matching search issuer/audience. The client supports per-request rotating credential files; memory does not mint credentials.
Expiry tombstones are emitted on active reads or explicit archive_expired/backfill, not by a new wall-clock daemon; canonical expiry is checked independently during every retrieval.
The broad regression includes 19 skipped optional tests; the new real-Postgres memory HTTP integration test ran and passed.
